==About==

{{i|Roasted Testicles}} are obtained when crafting {{i|Roasted Nuts}} using {{i|Testicles}} over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}.
